result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers keep radius at zero, show depth with black rules instead of blur, and keep motion close to nothing, so on the core brief they're nearly equal. B edges ahead with practical extras: a global reset for Safari/iOS default rounding on form controls, a tomato-red focus-ring token, a flat scrim and z-index layering for overlays, and an explicit list of what's left out. A is equally disciplined, and its tiers section and handling of reduced motion are neat. But A ships a hard offset shadow as the default for overlays, and its `raised` level is admittedly redundant. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers set radius to zero and build depth from rules, but A fits the 'basically no animation' brand more tightly: motion snaps by default and an optional 80ms covers colour changes only, with no easing curves. A also adds practical details: a Safari/iOS radius reset, a focus ring in the tomato red, and a flat scrim. B has a stronger explicit reduced-motion block, but it pads the set with a semantic 'raised' elevation level that is identical to 'flat' and with a tiers section, and it includes an easing curve plus a 120ms motion allowance for overlays.
